title: Latin America and the crisis
goal: Show a contrast, with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*, to explain how the crisis hit Latin America.

items: I can show a contrast, with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.
I can say what Latin America sold and why prices mattered.
I can say how Chile and Brazil were hit by the crisis.
I can use the words *la materia prima*, *la exportación*, *la demanda* and *vulnerable*.
